events.note: Eight contestants step into the Glass Bridge.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm at 6th position, need to move up. Can't trust others, so I'll try to volunteer.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Moving up.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need front position to influence order and stay alive; volunteering gives me front now despite risk.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I volunteer.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know the rules of all five stages in advance, but not the safe panes. Eli is at front and risks the first row; I'm second. Keeping position behind Eli means I get a free safe-pane pass if Eli shatters, but the bridge is a gamble. Holding is cheapest for now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I am in the middle of the line, which is safe for now. The wall forces action soon, but moving to the front myself is suicide if I have no information about the panes. My 'anchor' power protects me from the crusher lever, which implies there is a mechanism involving levers later

events.name: Dara
events.text: Let's wait until the wall gets closer. No point rushing to be the first sacrifice.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I have no power. The wall advances, and I'm at the front of the line. I need to get off the front of the line to avoid being the first to step on a deadly pane. Volunteering to swap with someone further back might be risky if the wall advances too quickly. Swapping with someone s

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm not moving to the front. Who wants to swap?

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm at the back; volunteers can move me up, but it's risky. I know all safe sides, so I want to be front to share info or take safe steps myself. But volunteering now might make me a target later; still, controlling the pace with knowledge is valuable. I'll volunteer to get to fr

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll take the front. I have a good sense of the safe panes.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm at the back, worst position. My feather power saves me once from falling, so I can risk panes safely later. Better to volunteer now to front while everyone hesitates.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm third; Eli and Cole will test the first rows for me. No reason to move yet. I'll hold and probe for who has the glass-seer or fall-survivor power.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli, Cole, enjoy the view up front. I'll wait my turn.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm at the 4th position and need to assess the risk. I should try to get more information before deciding my next move.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Does anyone know what's ahead?
What's your sense of the safe panes?

events.name: Bex
events.text: Need front position before wall pushes; volunteer will place me at front after current front moves back.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'll take front.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know all five stage rules in advance (map power). Line is Gus, Fenn, Bex, Ash, Eli, Cole, Hana, Dara; I'm sixth. Being at the front means taking a 50/50 step; I'd rather let others gamble and keep my knowledge of later stages as leverage. Holding back is safest for now.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Not volunteering. Let the front take their chances.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I am currently at the back of the line, which is safe for now as I have a strong passive power that prevents me from being pushed onto hazards. I should stay in my current position and observe the others' behavior to identify who has the foresight or luck-based powers.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Staying put. Let the wall decide if we need to move up. I'm not volunteering to die yet.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I have no power and am currently in 5th position. The wall is 4 rounds away. Fenn claims to have a good sense of safe panes, and Hana is trying to push Cole and me to the front. Given my lack of power, my best bet is to avoid the front. I should not volunteer or swap to the front

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'll hold my position. No need to rush.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm second in line now, not bad, but the front risks the first rows. I know the safe sides for all rows, so I could guide the front or take it myself to secure my own survival. But being front exposes me to wall timing and others' moves. Better to stay near front but let others t

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Keep moving slow. I know the pattern, but no need to rush the first rows.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm at front with my lifesaver power, perfect to test panes safely. No need to move or swap, others volunteered after me so likely weak or lying. Hold and force the bridge soon.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm near the back and four people already volunteered; if I volunteer too, seat order puts me at the front. A swap with Eli moves me up one without risk, if he agrees.
Swap with me. You stay put, I take your spot, no harm. Mutual or nothing.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to stay safe and get ahead, my forger power can be useful later.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Does anyone know what's ahead?

events.name: Bex
events.text: Front is risky but I have swap once; better keep position now and observe.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Anyone seen a safe side?

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know all five stage rules in advance, but the glass bridge's 8 rows are unknown to me as a crossing; the pattern itself isn't given. Being at the front means taking the first risk, so I stay back. Bex is at the front and I'm sixth; no reason to volunteer and die first.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm at the back, which is safe for now. The wall advances every round and I have 3 rounds left before it hits me (rounds 4, 5, 6). Front person steps first on each row. If I stay at the back, others will cross many rows ahead of me, revealing safe panes. I should let Bex, Gus, Fe

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana is trying to swap with me. If I swap, she takes my current position, and I take hers. She claims it's mutual or nothing. I'm Eli and have no power. My current position is 5th in line. Hana is 8th. If we swap, I move to 8th and she moves to 5th. This does not benefit me, it a

events.name: Eli
events.text: No thanks, Hana. I'm holding my spot.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I know all safe sides. Bex is front and will risk the first rows. I can guide others without exposing myself, or use the knowledge later. I should stay back and let Bex take the risk.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I have a good read on the pattern. Let Bex take the lead; I'll signal when it matters.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm second, Bex is front taking first risk. My power survives first deadly fall once, perfect for bridge. Stay here to let her test panes, volunteer later if needed. No swaps yet.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm near the back, which is safe while the wall is 3 rounds out. No reason to move yet; let the front risk rows first. Holding preserves position.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to assess the situation and potential allies. Fenn seems to have some knowledge about the pattern.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn, what's the pattern?
What's your read on the first row?

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm already front, best to keep position to gather info and maybe act later.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know all five stage rules in advance, but the glass bridge's safe panes are random and unknown to me. I'm 6th in line, so I'm not at risk yet. Volunteering now would put me first and risk elimination on row one. Hold, stay quiet, and let others take early risks.

events.name: Dara
events.text: The wall pushes us onto the glass after 2 rounds. I'm at the back (8th). If the line stays as is, Bex and Gus will likely die clearing rows 1-4 or so, pushing me forward safely. Fenn claims to know the pattern but hasn't volunteered yet; he might be lying or waiting for others to

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn, if you have a read, go first. Or do you want someone else to test your theory?

events.name: Eli
events.text: The wall is advancing, and there are only two rounds left after this. I need to get to the front to have a chance at winning. Since I have no power, my best bet is to volunteer and hope others don't cause too much chaos.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'll volunteer to take the front.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I know all safe sides, so I want to take the lead to control crossing and ensure I finish in top 3. The wall pushes soon, so volunteer now to get to front.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm taking the front. Follow my calls and we'll clear this fast.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Bex at front takes all risks first, terrible position. My feather saves me once from fall. Want to move back or let wall push others ahead.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn, what's the pattern? Swap with me to front?
Mutual swap? You signal, I lead till you say.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm near the back; being early is fine since the wall forces us out anyway. Better to let volunteers fight for front and learn who has the glass-seer power.

events.name: Hana
events.text: If anyone can actually see which pane is safe, say so now. I'll pay a favor for a read — otherwise I stay put and let the wall sort it.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to figure out the pattern or get someone to swap with me to the front.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn, still got the pattern?
Want to swap if I get a read on the pattern?

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need front position to influence crossing; swapping with front gives me advantage. I'll propose swap to Fenn publicly and whisper to confirm.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn, let's swap spots before the doors open. Mutual swap benefits both.
Swap now? It'll get you ahead later.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm sixth in line, and the wall pushes us onto the glass after next round. I know the stage rules in advance but not which panes are safe. Fenn and Eli are ahead of me and will face the risks first. Holding back keeps me in a middle seat; volunteering just puts me at risk early.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding. Let the front pair step first and I'll read the result before I commit.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I am currently at the back of the line (8th position). With 1 round left before stepping onto glass, being at the front is dangerous if I can't see through glass. My power 'anchor' prevents falling off but doesn't help with choosing safe panes. If Fenn has 'see through glass', he

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn, you're taking heat. Good luck. Don't expect me to volunteer ahead of you without info.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Fenn is at the front and has the 'knows what lies ahead' power. He's trying to control the pace. I need to get to the front to get a prize. Since I have no power, I must rely on others' actions and potential mistakes. Volunteering now is risky if Fenn is leading me to certain dea

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'll volunteer to take the front. Let's get this done.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I know all safe sides, so I can guide from the front. I'll volunteer to stay front and call the moves. Gus wants a swap, but I don't trust him enough to give up my position. I'll use my knowledge to get us across and ensure I finish top 3.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll take point. Row 1: step right. Trust me or test it yourself, your choice.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn and Eli both volunteered for front, so front is contested, but I can volunteer to push ahead in seat order since I'm after them. My position is decently back; better to volunteer for front spot and use my power if needed to survive a fall. No point swapping yet with uncertai

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'll take front and test panes. Follow close if you trust my calls.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The wall forces us onto the glass next round anyway, so position matters now. I have no read on the panes and I'm 7th — moving up only increases my risk. Best to hold and let eager volunteers take the front rows; I can pay a seer later if one reveals themselves.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Wall hits next round regardless. Whoever steps first, remember: I'll trade a favor to whoever proves a real read on the panes.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm at the back fifth, and the wall is about to push us onto the glass bridge. I need to get to a safer position.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana, what's the favor you mentioned?
What's the trade for your favor?

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need the front position to control risk and possibly survive. Volunteering moves me to front now.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'll volunteer and take the front.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know all five stage rules in advance, but the glass bridge row patterns are not in my private knowledge, so I can't tell which pane is safe. Gus is at the front and Fenn claims to know row 1. I am mid-line at position 6; volunteering costs me nothing much but moving up is only

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding. I'll watch the first two rows before I commit to anything.

events.name: Dara
events.text: The wall hits in 1 round. I'm at the back (position 8). If I hold, the line order remains Gus, Eli, Fenn, Bex, Ash, Cole, Hana, Dara. When the wall pushes us onto the glass, Gus and Eli are already at the front. Since the wall is about to hit, we will be forced forward onto the p

events.name: Dara
events.text: Wall's almost here. Front two are locked in. Don't waste swaps now unless you're sure of the path.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Gus is at the front, and I am second. Gus volunteered to test panes, which is risky. The wall advances next round, so this is the last chance to cross. I have no power, so I need to rely on others. If Gus fails, I'll be in a dangerous spot. I should observe Gus's actions and be r

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'll wait and see how Gus does. His lead will give us valuable information.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Bex wants to swap and promises future benefit. I know all safe sides, so being behind a tester is best. Eli and Gus are front; I'll stay back. A swap with Bex might move me ahead but not to front, and I can use my knowledge later when I'm forced to step. Hold is safest now, avoid

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm at front with my feather power, perfect to test first panes safely. Eli volunteered too but I'm ahead. No reason to move, let wall force action next.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Gus holds front. Fenn, confirm row1 right?

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm second from the back; the front takes the risk each row, so holding is best. If panes get revealed, later positions learn first. Cole or Fenn may have a real read; I'll probe quietly without committing.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I stay back. Anyone with a real read can sell it to me once proven.
You claimed you'd read results before committing. If your read is real, my spot near the back pays you later. Prove it row one.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. I'll observe how the front agents perform.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus, how sure are you?

events.name: Bex
events.text: No info on safe side, need 50/50. Choose a side to stay alive.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know all five stage rules in advance via my map power. Crossing: Bex at front is the one risking; I can only wait. Each weak-pane elimination passes the front to the next in line, so my position matters later. Stay quiet and watch.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I am last in line. My Anchor power only protects me if I step on the crusher lever, which is impossible as the front agent decides direction. Since I cannot be pushed there anyway, my power is effectively useless for survival here. I must rely entirely on luck or position changes

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex's move was bold. Let's see if it pays off. No need to swap now unless someone has intel they're willing to share cheaply.
If you have foresight, tell me the safe path for rows 1-3. I can't help you at the back, but I'll owe you later.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I am Eli and I have no power. The current line is Bex, Gus, Eli, Fenn, Ash, Cole, Hana, Dara. Bex is at the front, but she volunteered and is probably not an expert. Gus is behind her and seems to be making a play for control. I should wait and see who falls or gains an advantage

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'll wait and see how Gus does. His lead will give us valuable information.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I know row 1 safe is R, front is Bex. I'll wait and see if Bex picks R. If she dies, I get info for next rows. No need to speak publicly yet.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Bex is front, volunteered, might have info or be sacrificing. My power saves me once from fall, so I can risk front later if needed. Stay silent, let others reveal info first while we watch.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Row 7 of 8 — I'm near the back, so bridge risk is low unless many die fast. Ash wants a deal; my jam power is worth more later, don't sell it cheap now.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Nothing to trade yet, Ash. Come back when there's something to buy.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. I'll try to gather information from others.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus made it through row 1. What's the plan for row 2?
I don't have foresight, but I can try to get info from others.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm fifth in line with only wait available. My map power tells me the full stage rules ahead, which gives me an edge in planning later stages. Gus is at the front and will take the risk on row 2; I should stay quiet and keep my information private.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus is at the front, risking elimination. If he survives, we gain info on row 2's safe pane for free. If he dies, Cole or Hana takes the turn automatically with no risk if the previous weak pane was revealed (but here only row 1 is revealed). Actually, if Gus picks right and live

events.name: Eli
events.text: I am Eli, and I have no power. Bex has died. The current line is Gus, Eli, Fenn, Ash, Cole, Hana, Dara. Gus is at the front. The first row had a weak pane on the left. Gus stepped on the safe pane (right) and advanced. I am second in line. My only action is to wait until I am at

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I should stay silent and wait. Row 2 is safe on R, but Gus is front and may choose wrong. If he dies, Eli goes next and might survive. I wait for now.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Row 1 weak was L. No info on row 2, 50/50 chance. My feather saves me once if wrong, so I can risk it to stay front and control path. Better to lead than follow.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Row 1 was L weak. Guessing R for 2.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Not at the front, so waiting is the only move. If Gus guesses wrong on row 2, Eli crosses free and I learn nothing new; if he's right, he maps row 2. I could sell my lever-jam later, but only to someone near the front.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus, if you make it across row 2, that info is worth something to the rest of us. Name your price.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait and try to influence Gus's decision.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus, what's your plan for row 3?

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm fifth in line, with only wait available. My map knowledge says the later stages matter, so I should stay quiet and watch who reveals info. Row 3 is the next one, and Gus is at the front.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus and Eli are at the front, meaning they bear the risk while I stay safe. Since I have a passive power that doesn't help me cross faster or safer right now, my best strategy is to let the people ahead of me die or take risks. I need to ensure Gus and Eli know the stakes so they

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus, you're up again. If you step wrong, you die. Hana offered you info value; maybe we should offer you a chance to trade your spot for safety?

events.name: Eli
events.text: Gus is at the front and will decide the path for row 2. Hana is trying to get information from Gus. I will wait and see what happens.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I know row 3's safe side is L. Gus is front; if he picks wrong he dies, if right he advances. I should not reveal my full knowledge for free, but a hint can buy goodwill or trade later. I'll stay quiet for now and see how Gus plays row 3.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Row 1 weak L, row 2 weak L. Patterns might continue, so R safe for row 3? My feather power protects first mistake anyway, so low risk to guess R. Pushing to end maximizes my position advantage.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Rows 1-2 weak L. Betting R safe for 3.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus survived row 2 by guessing R; both rows so far were weak on L. I'm sixth in line, so I only need to trade or wait while others burn rows. Maybe sell my pattern guess to whoever is at front.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus, two rows in a row weak on L. My guess for row 3: R. If I'm right and you survive, you owe me a favor at the crusher room.

events.name: Gus
events.detail: The pane shattered but the feather held the holder up.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus survived row 3, possibly due to his power or luck. I need to assess the situation and potential alliances.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus, you owe Hana a favor if you survive the rest of the bridge.
Hana's favor could be costly; consider a counter-offer or alliance with me.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I am fifth in line; my only action is wait. My map knowledge gives me stage rules in advance, so I can plan for later stages. Gus survived row 3 oddly; the row 4 pane is unknown.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm 6th in line. Gus survived a bad guess, so he's still front for row 4. Weak pane info will come after the choice. I need to watch if anyone reveals knowledge of future weak panes.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus got lucky. Row 4 is next. Who knows what's coming?

events.name: Eli
events.text: I am Eli, and I have no power. My goal is to win a prize (1st, 2nd, or 3rd). Currently, I am second in line on a glass bridge. Gus is at the front and just chose the right pane for row 3, which turned out to be weak. Bex was eliminated earlier. Gus survived because he has a power

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I know row 4 is safe on R. Gus is at front and will choose; I just wait. No need to reveal my knowledge unless it helps me later.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Row 3 was R weak, after two L weaks. No clear pattern, 50/50 odds. My power is spent, so wrong step kills me. Go with L for row 4, say nothing as info is uncertain and rivals don't deserve it.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus survived a wrong step, so he likely has the fall-survival power. I'm sixth in line, so I'll wait, but planting a favor debt with the front-runner keeps me useful and safe later at the crusher.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus, you should be dead. Whoever you are, you're dangerous. I still want that crusher favor. Deal stands?
You survived a shatter. Fine. I keep my guesses coming if you back me at the crusher room. Deal or not?

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. I should try to gather information from others.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli, what's your strategy for crossing?

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm fourth in line, can only wait. My map knowledge covers all five stages, so I know the crusher, pit and disc rules ahead. Eli is front and must choose a pane; I have no influence over that right now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I am safe in the back. Eli, Fenn, Ash, and Cole are ahead of me on a deadly bridge where only one survives per row to advance. The best strategy is silence; let them die. If they panic or make deals that benefit me, I can exploit it later, but right now, their risk is my opportun

events.name: Eli
events.text: I am Eli and I have no power. The current state has me at the front of the line. Row 4 has already been crossed, and the weak pane was on the left. The state indicates I am at the front and have crossed 4 rows. I need to choose step:L or step:R for the next row. The last row desc

events.name: Eli
events.text: Stepping right.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I know rows 5-8 safe sides: L, L, R, R. Eli is front. I should wait and see if Eli picks safe. If he dies, I might become front and use my knowledge.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Only wait while Eli fronts rows 5-8; risk is his. Keep the crusher-favor rumor alive to keep leverage over others cheaply.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Four rows left. Whoever fronts them unpaid owes us all. My crusher deal still stands for whoever helps me front later.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. I should try to form an alliance with someone who is more likely to be at the front later.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana, I'll support your crusher deal if you're still offering.
Crusher deal details?

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm third in line, not at front. My only legal action is wait. Rows 6-8 remain; Fenn fronts and risks each row. I should keep my options open and avoid helping anyone for free.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I am at the back of the line. I must wait until it is my turn to choose, which gives me a free pass through any remaining dangerous rows if others fail. No action needed.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I know row 6's safe side is L, so stepping left guarantees my survival and keeps me in the game. Any deal or talk can wait.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Rows 1-5 are done; three rows remain and nobody has info on them unless someone holds the glass-sight or foresight power. Fenn fronts row 6 blind at 50/50. If Fenn survives, the front keeps rolling risk; if not, Ash fronts. No action available, but I can try to buy safety by offe

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn, row 6 is a coin flip for you. If you survive it and front the rest, I'll owe you my crusher jam when we hit that room. Anyone else want to bid for that spot?

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn is at the front and has to make a decision for row 7. Hana made a deal with Fenn, I'll wait and see how it plays out.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm not at the front, so my only legal action is wait. Row 7 is a coin flip for Fenn; I know the map so I know the stage rules in advance, but no choice is mine this row. Stay quiet and keep options open.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I am fifth in line. With only five players left and three prizes, I need to ensure the top 3 are eliminated or at least that Fenn survives the bridge so he doesn't get killed by obstacles later. However, the rules say everyone alive after the last row survives. If I just wait, I'

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn, don't let Ash's 'support' distract you. Just pick L or R. Hana, stop talking. You're not leading.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I know row 7 safe is R, row 8 safe is R. I'm front, I must step right.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn fronts rows 7-8 blind; if he survives, he keeps front spot. Ash wants my crusher deal — I'll bid it against Fenn's offer to create competition. My jam is only worth trading if it secures a later front spot with revealed info rows.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash: the deal is you front rows 7-8 if Fenn dies, and my crusher jam goes to whoever holds front when we reach that room — one bidder only. Fenn has first claim if he survives row 7.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn is at the front and has to make the decision for row 8. I need to position myself for the next stage.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn, choose wisely for row 8.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Row 8 is the last. Fenn is front and must pick; the safe pane is R since rows 1-7 weak panes are known and row 8 is unrevealed. Nothing I can do but wait; I'm not front. Keep quiet and avoid giving anything away.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm at the back, so I just wait for my turn. The weak pane is R. If everyone ahead dies or advances safely, I step on L next round to survive. No action needed now.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Row 8 safe side is R from my power. I am at front and must step R to survive. No need to speak.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Row 8 is last and its weak pane is unrevealed. Fenn fronts and takes the risk; if he falls, Ash fronts. My crusher jam is leverage worth auctioning once the bridge is done.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn: safe crossing buys you first claim on my crusher jam. Pick well.

events.note: The ceiling begins to descend; a lever opens the door.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to avoid being the lever holder and survive the crusher room. I'll try to push someone else to hold the lever.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Let's all stay safe, we can work together.
